items.title: Add a warn-only PreToolUse hook that detects CJK in git commit and lattice story-metadata commands
items.context: Model after the existing UserPromptSubmit hook in .claude/settings.json. Hook reads tool_input.command from stdin JSON; when the command matches git commit or lattice story_create/checklist_add/checklist_update/decision_set/understanding_set/summary_set, scan for CJK codepoints (U+4E00-9FFF plus common CJK ranges). On match, print a warning to stderr and exit 0 (non-blocking). Hook must be self-contained (no dependency on dist) per the pre-push external-defense principle.
items.userSees: After a commit or lattice-metadata command containing Chinese, the terminal shows a warning like: warn: artifact contains non-English (CJK) text; Lattice artifacts must be English. The command still proceeds.

happy.desc: A git commit or lattice story-metadata Bash command containing CJK triggers the hook to print an english-only warning to stderr

edge.desc: English-only commands and non-matching Bash commands produce no warning and exit 0

adversarial.desc: Malformed/empty stdin or missing tool_input does not crash the hook; it exits 0 (never blocks)

verificationEvidence.note: smoke Test 6 spawns english-only-guard.cjs with a CJK git-commit and lattice metadata command; hook prints the english-only warning on stderr and exits 0
smoke Test 6: English-only command and non-matching (unguarded) Bash produce no output and exit 0
smoke Test 6: empty/malformed stdin makes the hook exit 0 without crashing (warn-only, never blocks)

items.title: Add a diff/story-scoped CJK gate to lattice validate that hard-blocks REVIEW to TEST on non-English commits or story metadata
items.context: Add a CJK scan to the validate preflight alongside --lint. Scope strictly to the current story/branch: scan git log main..HEAD commit subjects and bodies and the current story author-controlled metadata (background.md, index.json title/description, checklist.json text fields, decision.json, understanding.json, plan.md, summary.json). Exclude framework/reviewer-generated or pure-runtime files to limit false positives. Fail (non-zero) when CJK is found so REVIEW to TEST is blocked; pass on English-only.
items.userSees: lattice validate fails with: CJK detected in artifact(s): <file/commit> line N; Lattice artifacts must be English, so REVIEW to TEST is blocked. On English-only artifacts validate stays green.

happy.desc: With a CJK commit message or current-story metadata, the validate preflight english-artifacts gate fails non-zero and names the offending file/commit, blocking REVIEW to TEST

edge.desc: On English-only commits and metadata the gate passes and validate stays green

adversarial.desc: A legacy Chinese file outside the current story (e.g. another story dir or CLAUDE.md) is NOT flagged

verificationEvidence.note: smoke Test 4 + standalone proof: a CJK fixture commit/metadata flips english-artifact-gate ok=false naming source+line, blocking REVIEW to TEST
smoke Test 4: English-only commits+metadata return ok=true; lattice validate green on this story (gate passes)
smoke Test 3: legacy Chinese in a path outside the current story dir is NOT flagged by english-artifact-gate (diff/story-scoped)

items.title: Tests: unit-test the CJK detector (positive/negative/scope) and prove the validate gate blocks a CJK fixture and passes English-only
items.context: Unit test the detector: Chinese string is detected; pure ASCII/English is not detected; mixed allowed ranges. Scope test: a legacy file outside the current story is not flagged. Integration: a fixture commit message or story metadata with CJK makes the validate gate fail; English-only passes. Keep tests fast (no real subprocess where a stubbed input suffices).
items.userSees: lattice validate runs the new CJK detector tests green; a deliberate CJK fixture flips the gate to fail, confirming the block is real and not silent.

happy.desc: cjk-detect unit cases: a Chinese string is detected; pure ASCII/English is not

edge.desc: Scope test: a fixture path outside the current story is not flagged by the gate

adversarial.desc: Keep-in-sync test: the self-contained hook CJK range matches the core detector range
